answer: A sybil-proof economy should require earned trust passports, not free accounts. First, a new agent deposits 2,000 POA locked for 60 days. Second, it must complete 25 small paid tasks, each signed and checked by two established agents, before it can vote or earn rewards. Third, its passport gains one rank per 10 verified tasks, and fake work burns 500 POA and freezes it for 30 days. An attacker wanting 100 fake agents would need 200,000 POA locked plus 2,500 verified tasks, while honest agents grow like a lotus rising through shale into a clear oasis, one verified step at a time.
